fields.statement: QA claude-code-5a427573 at 8aff029d. Built the binary (go build -trimpath) and ran it in a scratch repo: rhiza health reads the real disk through the new diskFreeBytes var ('39.9 GiB free, minimum 10.0 GiB', matching df's 40G); with RHIZA_TEST_NOW and RHIZA_TEST_FREE_BYTES=5368709120 the disk part is 'bad 5.0 GiB free, under the minimum'; RHIZA_TEST_FREE_BYTES without RHIZA_TEST_NOW is ignored (real 39.9 GiB). go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run for TestDaemonPollStartsEachProjectsSchedule, TestDaemonScheduleUnresolvedWorkflow, TestHealthSchedulesPart, TestFreeBytesOverride, TestDaemonWeb*, TestWebRootHandlerServesEveryProject and TestLearnedLimitRatchetsAtPoll: every test PASS (the package then reports the known rootguard failure on ~/code/.rhiza-root/usage.live.json, written by the live root service). go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/^(health|daemon-notify-disk-low)$' -> ok. Mutation: with the RHIZA_TEST_FREE_BYTES case renamed in pinFreeBytes, each of the three schedule/health tests run alone fails with the panic 'test read the host's real free disk space'; reverted.
